# PC Garage

> PC Garage is a premier gaming hardware retailer based in Dubai, UAE, specializing in custom gaming PCs, AMD-powered builds, and high-end computer components. Serving competitive gamers, 4K enthusiasts, and content creators across the UAE.

## About

PC Garage operates from a physical retail location at M25, Computer Plaza, Al Ain Center, Al Mankhool, Dubai, UAE. The company partners exclusively with AMD technology and positions itself around the philosophy: "Tuned for Glory, Powered by AMD." With over 30,000 satisfied customers, they offer both new and refurbished hardware with same-day service availability.

- Phone: +971 58 578 3085
- Email: info@pcgarage.me
- WhatsApp: Available
- Social: Instagram, Facebook, Twitter (@pcgarage)

## Products & Services

### Graphics Cards
- New: AMD Radeon RX 9000 Series, RX 7000 Series, RX 6000 Series, AI Pro Series
- Refurbished: RX 9000, 7000, 6000, 500 Series
- Featured brand: XFX AMD
- Price range: AED 3,079 to AED 6,599

### PC Components
- Gaming Processors (AMD)
- Motherboards
- Desktop Memory / RAM
- SSDs
- Power Supplies
- PC Cases
- Liquid Coolers

### Gaming Peripherals & Furniture
- Gaming Monitors
- Gaming Chairs

### Build Services
- Custom PC builder (Build Your PC tool): https://www.pcgarage.me/buildyourpc
- Pre-built gaming rigs
- Component upgrades
- New and refurbished options

- AMD specialization: Zen processors and RDNA graphics
